author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯ ಜೀವನಕೆ ಹೋರಾಡುತಿರಬೇಕು
ಸುಮ್ಮನೆಯೆ ಕೂತಿರಲು ಅನ್ನ ಹುಟ್ಟುವುದೆ
ಬಿಮ್ಮನೇ ಯೋಚಿಸುತ ಬಿಗುಮಾನ ಬದಿಗಿರಿಸೆ
ಹೊಮ್ಮುವವು ದಾರಿಗಳು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: For a peaceful life you must keep striving;
will food grow if you just sit idle?
if you think hard and set pride aside,
paths will open up, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Peace does not come from idleness; it has to be worked for. Think clearly, drop your pride, and a way forward will appear.
